user.name: E2E Test Coordinator

narratives.heading: Program overview
narratives.snippet: The Human Services BS program at E2E Test University prepares students for entry-level positions in social services through coursework, fieldwork, and capstone experiences. The program enrolls approximately 120 students per cohort and graduates 90% of admitted students within five years.
narratives.rationale: High-confidence match to the 'program description' spec.

narratives.heading: Mission alignment
narratives.snippet: The program's mission aligns with the university's strategic plan emphasizing community engagement and applied learning. Faculty meet quarterly to review alignment between course outcomes and the program mission statement.

narratives.heading: Strengths-based philosophy
narratives.snippet: Our program adopts a strengths-based, ecological systems framework consistent with social work and counseling traditions. Students learn to view clients as experts in their own lives and to assess situations through micro / mezzo / macro lenses.
narratives.rationale: Strong match to philosophical orientation spec.

evidenceText.heading: Sample syllabus excerpt
evidenceText.snippet: From HUSR 101 syllabus: 'Course objectives are aligned with the strengths-based perspective. Students will demonstrate the ability to identify client strengths in case-study assignments.'
evidenceText.rationale: Matches as evidence-text for philosophical orientation.

narratives.heading: Coordinator credentials
narratives.snippet: The program coordinator holds a Master's in Counseling and a doctoral candidacy in Higher Education Leadership. The coordinator has 15 years of experience in human services education and direct practice.
narratives.rationale: Direct match to coordinator credentials spec.
